measurement.cpu_policy: one CPU by inherited affinity; unchanged cpu.max retained in raw report, no finite quota claim
measurement.clock: per-request monotonic clock recorded by each retained host

diagnostic_pmu.policy: Unscored user-only raw PMU windows on the authenticated thread. No multiplex scaling; barrier/control edges included. Counts are not wall time or speedup.

current.limits: User-cycle period weights, not exact calls, allocation counts, wall-time shares or speedups. Own weights are disjoint; inclusive weights overlap. Caller/control barrier edges are included; missing/truncated frames remain explicit.

array_entry_census.resource_observation: Census drivers record admitted 4 GiB/no-swap/group-OOM policy and terminal OOM counters; terminal policy fields are not retained. The parent controller repeats admission for each child. No terminal-policy reread claim.
array_entry_census.limits: Authenticated execute-breakpoint counts of attempted native entries. #DB perturbs execution; no allocation, timing, causal-cost or exclusive-stage claim. Baseline cache/entry counts retain their own baseline source identity. Pump checkpoint is an external pump operation; promise_drain_jobs is internal queued-job draining and must not be counted as an external pump call.

physical_allocation_census.scope: Exact current P/R, natural GC, physical allocations including dead objects; copied survivors excluded; request and validation increments separate.

old_sampling_archive.scope: Archived 5aa compiler leaf sampling only; not refreshed or relabelled for the current compiler.

historical_source_qualification.qualification: Historical panels retain their archived compiler/source identities; none are refreshed or renamed as current-source evidence.
historical_source_qualification.resolution: Historical report SHA resolves inside this evidence archive; the live checkout path is replaced by the current report.

limits: All PMU, FP and execute-breakpoint cohorts are excluded diagnostics, not scored timings.
FP period weights are not allocation counts or wall-time shares; hardware entry counts are not timings.
No render, consume, or post-consumption sanity-scan stage clocks are available; do not attribute the full timed gap to React rendering.

The timed applicationRun includes Flight sanity parsing after stream consumption; outer JSON encoding and golden checks are outside the timer but can still affect later heap/JIT state through natural GC.
PMU caller counts and FP profiles do not provide exclusive wall-time attribution.
Physical allocation has separate controls/native-policy/source qualification; wall-time shares and semantic allocation origins are not inferred.

qualification.limits: Affected integration/source scopes only. Full CI, pinned Test262 and private units were not rerun. Existing unmodified formatting and Intl identity gates remain owned.

policy.aggregation: sum complete own/inclusive/actual helper_immediate_callers period counters across3processes; recompute full own/inclusive from all raw rows; never truncate before aggregation
policy.denominator: each group full period_sum, including host/unresolved and missing-IP mass
policy.own: one leaf owner/sample, categories disjoint and close exactly to total; top10 never renormalized
policy.inclusive: union of named family members per raw sample; family shares overlap. Pairwise overlaps retained; never sum family shares or treat as wall-time fractions
policy.callers: actual helper_immediate_callers field; per-sample owner/caller pairs deduplicated; distinct callers of same recursive helper may overlap, so caller sums may exceed inclusive owner mass

StoredValueDecode_source_supported_conte.has_instance: bound constructor target is unpacked via StoredValue.read_into; other paths perform observable @@hasInstance/prototype reads/calls
StoredValueDecode_source_supported_conte.function_call: bound-function target/this are unpacked in bound_function_record; argument/receiver transport has other inline value handling
StoredValueDecode_source_supported_conte.object_read: ordinary_get_probe decodes accessor getter; compact/intrinsic array and property storage paths also unpack values
StoredValueDecode_source_supported_conte.descriptor_query: compact ordinary-own-descriptor reads value and allocates snapshot; this is not all StoredValue decoding

policy.coverage: FP user-cycle period estimates, not exact instructions, calls, allocations or exclusive wall time; incomplete/missing chains retained; cannot numerically decompose the separate ~16x instruction gap

native_configuration.R: fixed precompiled SizeOptimized (Cranelift SpeedAndSize) + Backtracking in both modes

evidence_archive.policy: Regular UTF-8 evidence only; no native executables, Wasm, perf.data or cache blobs. SHA256 INDEX covers every evidence member.
